terra.problem: “Visitors at Pentecost” takes place in Jerusalem, not Pamphylia. The visitors came from Pamphylia.
“A sharp disagreement” takes place in Antioch, not Pamphylia. It refers back to Mark’s departure in Pamphylia.
“Sailing past on the way to Rome” takes place at sea off the coast of Pamphylia, not in the region itself.
Some wording may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader, including “declaring,” “companions,” “deserted,” and “voyage.”
